# swe-code-s1

- **Primary model:** qwen2.5-coder-1.5b (default when `model` omitted/unknown)
- **On demand:** any of qwen2.5-coder-1.5b, qwen3.5-0.8b, qwen3-0.6b, lfm2.5-350m via `model=`
- **Rule:** 1 model in memory at a time; switches are queued/serialized; unload after IDLE_UNLOAD_S=300s idle.
- **GGUF:** dataset `COMAND-CENTER-1/swe-code-hf-gguf`
- **Endpoint:** `https://comand-center-1-swe-code-s1.hf.space/v1/chat/completions` · status: `/status`
COMAND-CENTER-1/swe-code-s1.Dockerfile:
FROM ubuntu:24.04
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates python3 python3-pip tar gzip libgomp1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && pip3 install --break-system-packages -q huggingface_hub hf_transfer
ENV HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER=1
ARG LLAMA_URL=https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/releases/download/b12000/llama-b12000-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz
RUN mkdir -p /opt/llama /app /data/models \
    && curl -fsSL "$LLAMA_URL" -o /tmp/llama.tgz \
    && tar -xzf /tmp/llama.tgz -C /opt/llama \
    && rm /tmp/llama.tgz \
    && BIN=$(find /opt/llama -type f -name llama-server | head -1) \
    && test -n "$BIN" \
    && ln -sf "$BIN" /usr/local/bin/llama-server
COPY fetch_models.py /app/fetch_models.py
COPY manager.py /app/manager.py
COPY scaler.py /app/scaler.py
COPY entrypoint.sh /app/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /app/entrypoint.sh /app/fetch_models.py \
    && cd /app && python3 -c "import scaler"
ENV PYTHONPATH=/app
WORKDIR /app
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["/app/entrypoint.sh"]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Wake next Space when local CPU stays >= threshold. No Jobs. No router."""
from __future__ import annotations
import os, time, threading, urllib.request

THRESHOLD = float(os.environ.get("CPU_SCALE_THRESHOLD", "90"))
INTERVAL = float(os.environ.get("CPU_SCALE_INTERVAL_S", "10"))
STREAK = int(os.environ.get("CPU_SCALE_STREAK", "2"))
NEXT = (os.environ.get("NEXT_SPACE_URL") or "").rstrip("/")
COOLDOWN = float(os.environ.get("CPU_SCALE_COOLDOWN_S", "60"))

def cpu_pct() -> float:
    # /proc/stat sample
    def read():
        with open("/proc/stat") as f:
            parts = f.readline().split()
        vals = list(map(int, parts[1:]))
        idle = vals[3] + (vals[4] if len(vals) > 4 else 0)
        total = sum(vals)
        return idle, total
    i1, t1 = read()
    time.sleep(0.5)
    i2, t2 = read()
    di, dt = i2 - i1, t2 - t1
    if dt <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return max(0.0, min(100.0, (1.0 - di / dt) * 100.0))

def wake_next():
    if not NEXT:
        return False
    url = NEXT + "/v1/models"
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "swe-code-scaler"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            print(f"[scaler] woke next HTTP {r.status} {url}", flush=True)
            return True
    except Exception as e:
        # even errors can wake a sleeping Space
        print(f"[scaler] wake attempt {url}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}", flush=True)
        return False

def loop():
    print
COMAND-CENTER-1/swe-code-s1.fetch_models.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os, sys
from pathlib import Path
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

dataset = os.environ.get("GGUF_DATASET", "COMAND-CENTER-1/swe-code-hf-gguf")
token = os.environ.get("HF_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN")
out = Path(os.environ.get("MODEL_DIR", "/data/models"))
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
files = [f for f in os.environ.get("GGUF_FILES", "").split(",") if f.strip()]
if not files:
    print("GGUF_FILES empty", file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
if not token:
    print("HF_TOKEN missing", file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
paths = []
for f in files:
    f = f.strip()
    p = hf_hub_download(repo_id=dataset, repo_type="dataset", filename=f, local_dir=str(out), token=token)
    print("DOWNLOADED", f, "->", p, flush=True)
    paths.append(p)
Path("/tmp/model_paths.txt").write_text("\n".join(paths) + "\n")
COMAND-CENTER-1/swe-code-s1.entrypoint.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# One model in memory at a time; loaded on demand; unloaded after IDLE_UNLOAD_S (default 300s) idle.
set -euo pipefail
export GGUF_DATASET="${GGUF_DATASET:-COMAND-CENTER-1/swe-code-hf-gguf}"
export MODEL_DIR="${MODEL_DIR:-/data/models}"
export PRIMARY_MODEL="${PRIMARY_MODEL:-qwen2.5-coder-0.5b}"
export IDLE_UNLOAD_S="${IDLE_UNLOAD_S:-300}"
export NEXT_SPACE_URL="${NEXT_SPACE_URL:-https://comand-center-1-swe-code-s2.hf.space}"
export CPU_SCALE_THRESHOLD="${CPU_SCALE_THRESHOLD:-90}"
mkdir -p "$MODEL_DIR"
python3 /app/scaler.py &
export LORA_DATASET="${LORA_DATASET:-COMAND-CENTER-1/swe-code-loras}"
export LORA_SCALE="${LORA_SCALE:-1.0}"
export CODER_LORA="${CODER_LORA:-none}"   # qwen2.5-coder-0.5b
export QWEN35_LORA="${QWEN35_LORA:-none}"   # qwen3.5-0.8b
export LFM_LORA="${LFM_LORA:-none}"   # lfm2.5-350m
mkdir -p "$MODEL_DIR/loras"
exec python3 /app/manager.py
